{
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~notebook-window.read-only~1",
  "example": "typing into an open notebook",
  "files": {"notebook.md": "Alpha line one."},
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given notebook.md is open",
     "do": [{"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": true}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "notebook.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "opened"},
            {"file": "notebook.md", "as": "fixture"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.length == .fixture.size",
                 "why": "the view holds the whole of notebook.md"},
                {"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[0] | .offset == 0 and .text == \"Alpha line one.\"",
                 "why": "the view shows notebook.md from its first line"}]},
    {"line": "* When the user selects its first line and types \"x\"",
     "do": [{"drive": ["click",
                       {"jq": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[0].rect | .x + .width / 2 | floor"},
                       {"jq": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[0].rect | .y + .height / 2 | floor"},
                       "--count", 3]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "selected"},
            {"drive": ["type", "x"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "typed"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[0] as $l | .selected.json.sections.notebook.selection | .location == $l.offset and (.length == ($l.text | length) or .length == ($l.text | length) + 1)",
                 "why": "the triple click selected the first line, with its line break if it has one"}]},
    {"line": "* Then the first line is still selected",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": ".opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[0] as $l | .typed.json.sections.notebook.selection | .location == $l.offset and (.length == ($l.text | length) or .length == ($l.text | length) + 1)",
                 "why": "the selection after typing still covers the first line, with its line break if it has one"}]},
    {"line": "* And the text in the view is unchanged",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": ".typed.json.sections.notebook.length == .opened.json.sections.notebook.length",
                 "why": "typing added or removed no characters"},
                {"that": "def whole: .length as $n | [.drawn[] | select(.offset < $n)] | if length == 1 and .[0].offset == 0 and (.[0].text | length) == $n then .[0].text else null end; (.opened.json.sections.notebook | whole) as $before | $before != null and (.typed.json.sections.notebook | whole) == $before",
                 "why": "notebook.md has no line break, so before and after typing one drawn paragraph spans the whole text, every character of it observed and none reconstructed, and that text is the same"}]}
  ]
}
EOF
